<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F8FCFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="18" y="20" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="18" x2="326" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="338" y="13" width="3" height="5" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="343" y="11" width="3" height="7" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="348" y="9" width="3" height="9" fill="#000000"/>
  <circle cx="360" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="357" y1="18" x2="363" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="370" y="9" width="17" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="372" y="11" width="12" height="6" rx="1" fill="#00A47D"/>
  <rect x="387" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,59 23,66 31,73" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="66" x2="42" y2="66" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="66" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Set up your trip</text>
  <circle cx="358" cy="59" r="14" fill="#DDF4FF" stroke="#63C9F9" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="358" y="64" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">?</text>

  <!-- Progress -->
  <rect x="16" y="103" width="358" height="12" rx="64" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
  <rect x="16" y="103" width="119" height="12" rx="64" fill="#00A47D"/>
  <text x="16" y="135" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="900" fill="#6F6F70">STEP 1 OF 3</text>
  <text x="374" y="135" text-anchor="end" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#00A47D">33%</text>

  <!-- Main title -->
  <text x="195" y="178" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Where are you going?</text>
  <text x="195" y="207" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Tell us about your next adventure</text>

  <!-- Journey steps -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="68" cy="243" r="17" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <polyline points="60,243 66,249 77,237" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="86" y1="243" x2="173" y2="243" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="243" r="17" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <text x="195" y="249" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">2</text>
    <line x1="212" y1="243" x2="299" y2="243" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle cx="322" cy="243" r="17" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="322" y="249" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">3</text>
    <text x="68" y="275" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Language</text>
    <text x="195" y="275" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Destination</text>
    <text x="322" y="275" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Your goal</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Selected language card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="17" y="295" width="356" height="91" rx="14" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.35"/>
    <rect x="16" y="293" width="356" height="91" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="32" y="311" width="71" height="54" rx="11" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <rect x="32" y="311" width="23.7" height="54" rx="11" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <rect x="79.3" y="311" width="23.7" height="54" rx="11" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="56" y1="311" x2="56" y2="365" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="122" y="326" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">LEARNING</text>
    <text x="122" y="352" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">French</text>
    <polyline points="338,337 346,345 354,337" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Destination section -->
  <text x="16" y="426" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Your destination</text>
  <text x="16" y="451" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">We'll tailor lessons to the places you visit.</text>

  <!-- Complete form field -->
  <text x="16" y="486" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">DESTINATION</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="17" y="497" width="356" height="58" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.35"/>
    <rect x="16" y="495" width="356" height="58" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="524" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="49" y1="531" x2="55" y2="537" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="68" y="530" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">e.g. Paris, France</text>
  </g>
  <text x="18" y="576" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">You can change this later in your profile.</text>

  <!-- Travel vocabulary preview card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="17" y="602" width="356" height="102" rx="14" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity="0.35"/>
    <rect x="16" y="600" width="356" height="102" rx="14" fill="#DDF4FF"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="635" r="19" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <polygon points="48,620 52,631 64,631 54,638 57,650 48,643 39,650 42,638 32,631 44,631" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <text x="78" y="630" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Travel vocabulary</text>
    <text x="78" y="655" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#456B64">Learn phrases for cafés, trains,</text>
    <text x="78" y="677" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#456B64">directions, and meeting locals.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Disabled continue -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="721" width="174" height="48" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="103" y="751" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Continue</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Green CTA -->
  <g>
    <rect x="200" y="721" width="174" height="48" rx="13" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <text x="287" y="751" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Let's Do It!</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="785" width="390" height="59" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="16" y1="785" x2="374" y2="785" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="45,804 56,795 67,804 67,816 59,816 59,808 53,808 53,816 45,816" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="56" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="136" cy="805" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="136" y1="798" x2="136" y2="812" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="129" y1="805" x2="143" y2="805" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="136" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Practice</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="230" cy="805" r="11" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <polygon points="230,797 232,803 239,803 234,807 236,813 230,809 224,813 226,807 221,803 228,803" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="230" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#00A47D">Learn</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="326" cy="801" r="6" fill="#6F6F70"/>
    <ellipse cx="326" cy="814" rx="11" ry="6" fill="#6F6F70"/>
    <text x="326" y="833" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
